## Mouser v3.7.18 - multi-monitor screenshot overlay fix

This release fixes a Windows multi-monitor region screenshot overlay artifact.

### Fixed

- The screenshot selector now uses one visible shade window per display instead
  of one large transparent window spanning the whole virtual desktop.
- Opening region screenshot mode should no longer show a partial highlighted /
  undimmed patch on one monitor before you start dragging.
- Cross-monitor selection still uses one shared global rectangle, so dragging
  across displays continues to work.

### Notes

- Public source and release packages do **not** include personal config, logs,
  screenshots, or Mouser/G502 backups.
